A second route confirms it: the normal is <2, 3, 6> whose length is 7, so the plane falls one unit short along that normal, and one unit of the left-hand side is 1/7 of a metre of actual displacement. Doubling the numerator by dropping the absolute value would give a signed distance, not a length.
